units.source_text: 一本解说书解释说：风化和水的侵蚀造成了泥土的分解，

en.t: One explanatory book states that weathering and water erosion cause the decomposition of soil,

units.source_text: 其结果又极单纯地把泥土的分解物按轻重顺序远远抛开去。

en.t: and as a result, quite simply, the decomposed materials are cast far apart in order of their weight.

units.source_text: 但是，直径1/8mm的特别意义却无法挑明。

en.t: However, it cannot clearly explain the special significance of a diameter of 1/8 mm.
